# mvstmt: extract code with infinite for loop (isTerm for ForStmt)
mv F:/BEGIN/+0,/END/-0 New
-- x.go --
package m

func F(x int) int {
	// BEGIN
	for {
		if x > 0 {
			return x
		}
		x++
	}
	// END
}
